why_it_exists: if the results ledger is wrong everything downstream is wrong
threshold: every club reconciles to the official standings; official score == mirror score
measured: 12 checks in results_checks.csv, 0 disagreements on 137 completed games

why_it_exists: a backtest that can see the future is not a backtest
threshold: ratings for a week use only earlier weeks, live and historical alike
measured: walk-forward: each week refit; 0 games used before their own date

why_it_exists: a rate on 30 bets is a story, not a rate
measured: 1255 on the largest division; live slate contributes 0 because Week 10 is unplayed

why_it_exists: each free knob is another chance to find noise
measured: 1-2 per strategy (the disagreement threshold); the rating core is shared and pre-registered (lambda=8.0, prior weight, 2 seasons) and identical across all strategies

why_it_exists: the best of many tries is not a discovery
threshold: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 over all registered variants
note: an honest failure: no variant clears multiplicity, which is exactly what the gate is for

why_it_exists: if nobody can out-forecast the market there is nothing to bet
threshold: |r| (predicted margin vs actual margin) >= 0.15 and not materially worse than the posted line
measured: predicted-vs-actual margin r = 0.2901 on n = 1274 walk-forward games; the posted line scores 0.4530 on the same games, so the model is worse than the market

why_it_exists: paper edges die at the window
threshold: graded at the price the source displayed; vig columns present per bet; no assumed -110
measured: 4799 bets graded at their own captured prices; 0 dropped for a missing price (counted, never filled)

why_it_exists: CLV is the only in-life evidence that you beat the market
measured: 0 rows in the store carry line_stage='closing' (store holds 0 rows: opening, pre_game and undocumented-vintage only)
note: BLOCKED BY DATA, not by method. The capture job writes a kickoff snapshot on each Sunday and Monday; from the second live week onward this gate can close. Until then no CLV claim is made.

why_it_exists: an unreproducible number is not a number
threshold: clean rebuild equals committed tables byte for byte; no wall-clock stamps in output
measured: verify.py compares rebuilt tables to the committed ones; CI runs both

why_it_exists: if a dumb rule matches you, you found a market, not a signal
threshold: exact McNemar p < 0.05 against every naive rule on the identical games
measured: 48 strategy/naive-rule pairs; 14 of them beat a dumb rule at p<0.05; minimum p per strategy ranges 0.0015 to 1.0000
note: not evaluated because no strategy cleared V-05: there is nothing to compare. If a strategy ever clears multiplicity, this gate runs before promotion, not after.

why_it_exists: the desk must be able to say no
note: nothing is promoted from backtest alone in this build; the board ranks and the gate holds
